checks.name: Crawlability and index eligibility
checks.inspection: Inspect response status, robots.txt, meta robots and X-Robots-Tag on sampled intended landing pages. Distinguish eligibility from confirmed indexing; use Search Console only when supplied/authorized.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled intended public pages are reachable and eligible for indexing, with intentional exclusions documented.
checks.applicability_note: An intentionally private site can justify N/A for index eligibility; record evidence of its purpose. Inability to access Search Console is untested indexing evidence, not N/A for this entire check.
checks.notes: All 9 metadata-sampled HTML pages return 200; public pages have no observed noindex; cart intentionally noindex,follow. robots allows public routes. Eligibility, not confirmed indexing.

checks.name: Canonical URLs and duplication controls
checks.inspection: Inspect canonical declarations, protocol/host variants and duplicate routes. Verify canonical targets resolve; do not infer Google selection without evidence.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled indexable pages use consistent, reachable canonical targets and intentional variant handling.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable to all public websites.
checks.notes: Nine metadata-sampled pages have matching final canonical URLs. No assertion about Google-selected canonical.

checks.name: Sitemaps and discovery
checks.inspection: Review robots-declared or directly located sitemap files, status, syntax and sampled listed URLs. Assess the need and alternative discovery paths.
checks.pass_criteria: Important pages have reliable discovery paths; available sitemaps are usable and list intended canonical URLs.
checks.applicability_note: A small one-page site with demonstrated complete discovery may justify N/A to sitemap-specific review; lack of sitemap access is not evidence of N/A.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Internal linking and crawl paths
checks.inspection: Follow representative navigation and contextual links; inspect broken destinations, important-page depth and orphan-page claims against the actual crawl scope.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled important pages are linked through usable paths without material broken internal links.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; qualify orphan-page conclusions unless a complete authorized URL inventory is available.
checks.notes: Homepage-linked representative destinations resolve 200. Not a complete link inventory.

checks.name: Structured data and localization accuracy
checks.inspection: Inspect existing structured data and hreflang where relevant; compare declarations to visible content and intended language/region variants.
checks.pass_criteria: Relevant declarations are valid, consistent with visible content and correct for the tested variants; unnecessary markup is not required.
checks.applicability_note: N/A may be justified when there is no relevant structured-data feature or alternate-language/region content. Show inspection evidence and rationale.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Page titles and search intent
checks.inspection: Inspect titles on each sampled page and compare uniqueness, subject, intent and clarity; character counts alone do not determine success.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled important pages have descriptive, differentiating titles aligned with their purpose.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable to public content pages.
checks.notes: Nine observed titles identify their distinct page purposes.

checks.name: Search descriptions and presentation
checks.inspection: Inspect meta descriptions and available observed search presentation, separating authored descriptions from search-engine rewrites.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled pages provide useful, accurate descriptions where appropriate without material duplicate boilerplate.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; a missing live search preview is not N/A for authored metadata.
checks.notes: Product/Home/Passport descriptions are specific; rewards, refund and privacy reuse generic homepage description. Cart duplication excluded as intentional noindex.

checks.name: Heading structure and main topic
checks.inspection: Inspect headings and main page topic in rendered DOM; avoid treating a count of H1 elements alone as a ranking defect.
checks.pass_criteria: Headings describe the content and form a coherent structure with an identifiable main topic.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Image and link context
checks.inspection: Inspect descriptive link text, relevant image alternatives/captions and contextual links. Avoid keyword stuffing; accessibility impact belongs to its own findings/checks.
checks.pass_criteria: Important links and meaningful images have accurate contextual descriptions appropriate to their purpose.
checks.applicability_note: Image-only subtests may be N/A when no meaningful images exist; links still apply.
checks.notes: Homepage sampled meaningful product links are named, and all images expose alt attributes. Not an image-by-image semantic audit of other templates.

checks.name: URL clarity and topical alignment
checks.inspection: Inspect URLs, breadcrumbs where relevant and visible main content against each page's intended search task; distinguish research-backed demand from inference.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled pages clearly align URL, title and substantive content with one coherent visitor task.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; do not invent search volumes or target-keyword data.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Field Core Web Vitals evidence
checks.inspection: Collect available CrUX/PageSpeed/Search Console field evidence; record source, device, URL versus origin, collection period, percentile and LCP/INP/CLS availability. Preserve a provider's reported assessment separately from missing metric coverage.
checks.pass_criteria: Representative field LCP, INP and CLS all have adequate evidence and meet current documented good thresholds. If any required metric is unavailable, this composite check is not_tested; retain any provider-reported pass separately with its limits. Use partial only for complete required evidence showing mixed good/non-good metrics or sampled segments.
checks.applicability_note: Insufficient field traffic or unavailable data means not_tested, not N/A and not fail. No inference from lab scores to real-user CWV.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Reproducible lab loading diagnostics
checks.inspection: Run or inspect authorized lab reports and record tool/version, tested URL, device/network profile, timestamp, cache state and repeated-run variability when available.
checks.pass_criteria: Available lab evidence shows no material loading bottleneck for the agreed tested scenario, with diagnostics supporting the conclusion.
checks.applicability_note: An unavailable lab tool means not_tested; avoid universal pass thresholds for a whole Lighthouse score.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Images, fonts and transferred assets
checks.inspection: Use measured requests or supplied traces to assess image sizing/formats, font behavior, transfer size, compression and request duplication.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled critical pages avoid material observed oversized/duplicated assets and use appropriate delivery settings.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; visual inspection alone cannot prove network byte savings.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Interaction and main-thread work
checks.inspection: Inspect supported traces or diagnostics for blocking scripts, long tasks, hydration or interaction delays; do not relabel TBT as INP.
checks.pass_criteria: Measured tested interactions and relevant main-thread diagnostics show no material responsiveness bottleneck.
checks.applicability_note: No supported trace or interaction measurement means not_tested.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Caching, delivery and layout stability
checks.inspection: Inspect actual cache/compression headers, resource delivery and observed layout shifts in the tested session. Qualify CDN/backend claims to accessible evidence.
checks.pass_criteria: Observed delivery policies suit resource sensitivity/update needs and no material avoidable layout instability appears in measured scenarios.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; do not penalize intentionally private no-store responses.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Keyboard access and visible focus
checks.inspection: Manually test representative navigation, menus, dialogs and forms using keyboard; inspect focus order, traps, visibility and focus return.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested critical journeys are keyboard usable with visible logical focus and no observed keyboard trap.
checks.applicability_note: Automated scans alone cannot pass this check; unavailable interaction testing means not_tested.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Accessible names and semantic structure
checks.inspection: Inspect rendered accessible roles/names, landmarks, headings, controls and meaningful image alternatives using available DOM/accessibility evidence.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled meaningful content and controls expose appropriate names, roles and structure.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; report sampled coverage, never a whole-site conformance certification.
checks.notes: Rendered homepage exposes main, H1, named navigation/search and recommendation controls; limited to homepage desktop states.

checks.name: Contrast, text resize and reflow
checks.inspection: Use measured contrast where possible and manually inspect text resizing/reflow at relevant viewport/zoom conditions; record tested states.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested text/UI states meet applicable current WCAG contrast/reflow requirements without losing essential content or functionality.
checks.applicability_note: Brand colors or screenshots without reliable measurement support hypotheses, not a measured contrast failure.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Labels, instructions and error recovery
checks.inspection: Inspect form labels, instructions, validation and error associations. Exercise only safe non-submitting states unless client authorization explicitly allows test submissions.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested forms communicate labels, requirements and actionable accessible error feedback.
checks.applicability_note: N/A requires evidence that the sampled site/journeys contain no forms or data-entry controls.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Media alternatives and motion controls
checks.inspection: Inspect captions/transcripts or other required alternatives for meaningful media, pause controls, flashing and reduced-motion behavior where relevant.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested meaningful media and animation expose the applicable alternatives and motion controls.
checks.applicability_note: N/A requires evidence that no relevant prerecorded/live media or moving content exists in the scope.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Responsive layout and reflow
checks.inspection: Inspect representative pages at recorded mobile and desktop viewport sizes, including menus, tables, overlays and orientation where possible.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested layouts preserve meaningful content and controls without material unintended clipping or horizontal overflow.
checks.applicability_note: A desktop-only screenshot cannot support a mobile pass.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Navigation and findability
checks.inspection: Trace primary visitor tasks through menus, search where present, breadcrumbs and back paths; note observed dead ends and unnecessary steps.
checks.pass_criteria: Key sampled tasks are discoverable with understandable labels and recoverable navigation.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; do not claim usability-study evidence without participants.
checks.notes: Homepage paths and tested destinations are named and reachable. Mobile interactions remain untested.

checks.name: Touch controls and mobile readability
checks.inspection: Inspect recorded mobile states for target usability, spacing, text legibility and sticky elements obstructing content or actions.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled mobile controls and reading states remain usable without observed obstruction or precision-dependent operation.
checks.applicability_note: Unknown device state or absent mobile inspection means not_tested.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Feedback, empty and error states
checks.inspection: Safely inspect loading, no-results, validation and error states reachable without destructive actions; state which states were exercised.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested states provide clear feedback and a route to recover or continue.
checks.applicability_note: Not reaching an error state is untested evidence, not proof that the state is correct.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Consistency of critical journeys
checks.inspection: Walk the agreed primary journey across representative templates; inspect terminology, controls, content hierarchy and cross-device continuity.
checks.pass_criteria: The tested journey uses consistent patterns and has no observed material interruption.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; scope the conclusion to tested journeys.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Value proposition and audience fit
checks.inspection: Compare the visible offer, intended audience and primary visitor problem against supplied client context; label inference when client context is absent.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled entry pages clearly explain the offer, audience and relevant benefit using supported statements.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable even to noncommercial sites, using their primary user outcome.
checks.notes: Homepage clearly presents beauty/Home, gifting, personalization and qualified NOW delivery.

checks.name: Primary calls to action
checks.inspection: Inspect clarity, visibility, expectations and destination of the primary CTA across tested pages and mobile states.
checks.pass_criteria: Primary actions are visible, understandable and lead to the intended next step without observed material friction.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable; do not infer conversion uplift from design changes.
checks.notes: Homepage named gift/shop/product links lead to observed destinations; full purchase flow untested.

checks.name: Trust and decision information
checks.inspection: Inspect verifiable contact details, offer/pricing terms where relevant, policy links, proof and claims. Do not invent testimonials or assurances.
checks.pass_criteria: Visitors receive the decision information and supported trust signals relevant to the stated offer.
checks.applicability_note: Use purpose-appropriate criteria; not every website needs reviews, pricing or checkout.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Lead or purchase journey friction
checks.inspection: Inspect the agreed funnel up to authorized boundaries; assess fields, steps, clarity and recoverability without purchasing or sending a lead by default.
checks.pass_criteria: Observed safe funnel steps are coherent and avoid material unnecessary friction for the stated visitor task.
checks.applicability_note: N/A only if the site's purpose has no actionable conversion journey; lack of transaction authorization means those steps are untested.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Conversion measurement evidence
checks.inspection: Inspect supplied analytics/event evidence or authorized read-only configuration; distinguish tag presence from verified collection and business outcomes.
checks.pass_criteria: Evidence supports defined primary conversions and correct relevant event collection for the tested configuration.
checks.applicability_note: No analytics access means not_tested, not N/A or proof that tracking is broken.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: HTTPS and transport hygiene
checks.inspection: Inspect public HTTPS behavior, observed certificate validity and HTTP redirect behavior within the permitted scope.
checks.pass_criteria: Tested public entry points use valid HTTPS and appropriate transport behavior without an observed material transport issue.
checks.applicability_note: This is a passive/basic review, not penetration testing or complete TLS assurance.
checks.notes: Sampled HTTPS responses succeeded with HSTS. Broader TLS/protocol matrix not assessed.

checks.name: Relevant browser security controls
checks.inspection: Inspect actual response headers and evaluate CSP, framing controls, MIME sniffing and referrer policy against the site's behavior and risk; avoid checklist-only critical ratings.
checks.pass_criteria: Observed browser controls are appropriate to the tested exposure with no material evidenced misconfiguration.
checks.applicability_note: A missing header alone does not demonstrate exploitation; document context and limits.
checks.notes: Delivered CSP includes frame-ancestors none, upgrade-insecure-requests; X-Frame-Options DENY, HSTS and nosniff. Passive hygiene, not penetration testing.

checks.name: Mixed content and insecure dependencies
checks.inspection: Inspect browser console/network evidence for insecure active resources and visible dependency delivery issues on tested pages.
checks.pass_criteria: No material insecure active dependency or mixed-content issue appears in the tested evidence.
checks.applicability_note: Missing console/network access means not_tested; do not infer a clean result from the page merely loading.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Observed cookie and form transport hygiene
checks.inspection: Inspect exposed cookie attributes and form destinations without collecting secrets or submitting credentials; apply Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite according to purpose.
checks.pass_criteria: Observed sensitive-cookie and form transport settings are appropriate to their documented role.
checks.applicability_note: N/A requires evidence that no relevant cookies or data-entry flows exist; inaccessible authenticated flows remain untested.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Visible technical exposure and broken states
checks.inspection: Review ordinarily accessed public responses for exposed secrets, debug output, stack traces and sensitive artifacts encountered naturally; do not enumerate exploit paths or scan aggressively.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled public responses show no observed sensitive disclosure or materially broken technical state.
checks.applicability_note: Absence in the sample is limited assurance; do not describe it as proof the site is secure.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Task completion and content usefulness
checks.inspection: Read representative pages against the intended audience and visitor task; distinguish substantive gaps from stylistic preference.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled content directly helps the intended reader complete the stated task with sufficient detail.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Accuracy and supported claims
checks.inspection: Check material claims against supplied/source evidence and flag unverifiable claims for verification; apply domain-appropriate caution.
checks.pass_criteria: Material sampled claims are supportable and do not visibly contradict reliable evidence.
checks.applicability_note: An inability to verify is needs_verification, not an automatic factual-failure assertion.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Clarity and readability
checks.inspection: Review organization, language, definitions and formatting for the intended audience; do not apply a universal reading-level target.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled content communicates its point clearly with appropriate structure and terminology.
checks.applicability_note: Usually applicable.
checks.notes: Observed homepage English labels and shopping next steps are understandable. No user research or full content audit.

checks.name: Freshness and maintenance cues
checks.inspection: Inspect dates, contacts, offer availability, references and change-sensitive information; distinguish undated evergreen content from stale content.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled time-sensitive content is current or clearly qualified, with no evidenced material stale information.
checks.applicability_note: N/A can be justified for a wholly evergreen scope after inspection; absence of a date alone is not failure.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

checks.name: Distinctiveness, depth and duplication
checks.inspection: Compare sampled pages for repetitive boilerplate, thin task coverage and useful differentiating detail; avoid plagiarism or AI-authorship claims without reliable evidence.
checks.pass_criteria: Sampled pages provide sufficient distinct task value without material avoidable duplication.
checks.applicability_note: Do not claim web-wide originality without an appropriately scoped comparison.
checks.notes: Required full criterion evidence not collected in this bounded sample; retain in verification backlog.

findings.title: Verify readiness wording and exclusivity claims in current ads
findings.remediation: Clarify available-to-order versus ready stock for the zero-stock CONTINUE option; verify exclusive first-drop evidence and 5% offer conditions before changing ad copy. No ads changed during this audit.
findings.validation: Check exact shade online availability/delivery promise and discount eligibility in an authorized cart preview; obtain substantiation for exclusivity.
findings.priority_basis: Risk tier first; benefit/effort within tier

findings.title: Measure recommendation loading latency across representative sessions
findings.remediation: Collect cold/warm mobile and desktop traces, then optimize sequential candidate/stock/fallback reads if the delay reproduces. One backend sample is not field CWV.
findings.validation: Record median and p95 API/render latency with device/network settings; verify relevance, consent and stock guardrails after changes.
findings.priority_basis: Risk tier first; benefit/effort within tier

findings.title: Generic descriptions on sampled rewards and policy pages
findings.remediation: Write purpose-specific descriptions without changing existing product descriptions.
findings.validation: Fetch those three pages again and verify distinct accurate meta descriptions.
findings.priority_basis: Risk tier first; benefit/effort within tier
